gaps.sentence: ___ spite of the traffic, we arrived on time.
The bridge is ___ repair, so traffic uses the bypass.
She's very good ___ explaining difficult ideas.
I'm not used to ___ such spicy food.
The scheme, ___ was announced yesterday, will cost the city millions.
gaps.explanation: Non-defining clauses about things take 'which'; 'that' is impossible after a comma.

gaps.sentence: By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: If I ___ you, I'd apologise immediately.
gaps.explanation: 'If I were you' — subjunctive 'were' for unreal situations.
